description: This file contains shell functions related to multi-pack index (midx) operations in git, including consistency checks, checksum calculations, mode comparisons, and testing various git commands with and without multiPackIndex enabled.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of midx files in a given directory by verifying the index files, comparing outputs from read-midx, and running git multi-pack-index verification.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of a midx file using the test-tool's read-midx command.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Runs git commands with multiPackIndex disabled and enabled, comparing their outputs. Optionally sorts the outputs for comparison if the 'sorted' argument is provided.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs a series of git commands with and without midx mode enabled to ensure they produce consistent results, with a descriptive message.
